pages.text: If left to grow on its own, the Ice Seed would one day take this very form, draining the storms of the frozen plains and rendering the frostbitten reaper unable to lift its scythe.

That was supposed to be its destiny. Alas, the Ice Core Seed, hidden for a century by the leader of the iceologers, was ripped out and taken away like killing the goose that laid the golden eggs. Fortunately, this seed was nearly mature, making it the final act of goodwill offered by that old wretch before his death.

This even requires little effort. Entrust the frost wand in your hand as the seed, and the Frostbloom will blossom in the void. It is a greater dominion of frost, releasing the cold stored for a thousand years without reserve, freezing every living thing that stands in its way. All ice-based spells bow before it, and even the caster's cooldown is frozen — all thanks to the seed within.Its power is so great that it can even grant frost magic the ability to freeze enemies.
The path of survival that the iceologers exhausted everything to carve out for the frozen soil has been cut off with a single stroke. How tragic.
